forbids: a board decision rendered as a raw Python dict repr instead of its text
note: Enrolled in v0.56.0 by BL-101/BL-99. This guard ships in seven skills and was discovered by none of them: filename convention globbed no-*.sh plus three literal names, and decisions-render.sh matched nothing. Never mutation-tested until now.

mutations.why: The shipped P1: the sidecar carries decisions as {"text", "altitude"} objects and the renderer stringified them, so the board read a raw Python dict. One half, because the guard asserts one property — the rendered page carries the decision TEXT and never the dict repr. The mutation restores the defect at the one expression that produced it.
defeats: no decision renders as a raw dict
